properties.Title: Starting Election Regulations
properties.UserDescription:
Elections may only be started on day 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29. In case an office is vacant, citizens may start an election immediately. The term of that official will end on the next regular election day.
This means, in code, that elections may only be started if the world age in days modulo 7 is less than 1. Example: on the middle of world day 15, the world is 14.5 days old. 14.5 mod 7 is 0.5 and therefore less than 1.

properties.Title: Credit Distribution
properties.UserDescription:
This law distributes credits to others every 6 hours if they are below a specific amount determined by the below formula. 

Non-Company players have a credit limit with the following formula. World Age in Hours * houlyUBI + 25 percent of income in the last 24 hours.
Company players have a creadit limit with the following formula. World Age in Hours * houlyUBI * + (25 percent of income in the last 24 hours / number of company members )

properties.Title: Automated Minting and Seigniorage Transferal
properties.UserDescription:
Once per day the Federal Mint will check to see if the UBI account has less than 300,000 euros, if this is the case it will top the account up and send ten percent of the minted sum as seigniorage into the Treasury of the Federal Government and ten percent of the minted sum is sent to the loan account.
The Director of the Federal Bank if appointed can freely adjust the minting seigniorage between 0% and 10% by contacting the Game Masters to change the amount inside this law. 10% is merely the default value.

civics.name: [C] Federal Salary Legislation
civics.description:
Purpose: This law manages government wages
Type: [C] Constitutional
Author: Daniel93a
Maintainer: Elmeye

Every hour, every member of the government gets a wage according to the index wage. The index wage is automatically adjusted based on inflation. Wages are paid out of different Government Accounts so the Government has to make sure to keep these stocked up. Owed wages are tracked.
Government members also receive a pension that is based on the index wage as well. The longer they serve, the more pension they receive. Pension payments are capped at 70% of the index wage.
